summary.name: Acapela Group
summary.one_liner: Acapela Group is a company offering personalized AI text-to-speech digital voices for any service, app, or device that needs to speak.
use_cases: adding a spoken voice to apps or services
embedding speech in devices such as rail passenger information systems
creating a custom branded digital voice
choosing an AI voice for a project
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Acapela Group as a provider of personalized AI digital voices for any service, app, or device that needs to speak. It says the catalogue covers over 30 languages and 200 voices, plus custom voices on request. A demo is offered, governed by terms that say the demo uses speech synthesis and voice generation technologies and must not be used for impersonation or unlawful content. The page also mentions a news item about Teleste embedding Acapela AI voices in rail passenger information, and offers a white paper to help choose an AI voice.
notable: Over 30 languages and 200 voices, plus custom voices
Embedded in third-party devices, e.g. Teleste rail passenger information
Public demo with AI Act-referencing usage terms
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Custom voice creation requires contacting the company
